row.body: The grounds sheet closes one course entrance for a pickup, but the meal receipt at that entrance is dated after the vehicle left.
row.title: The course notice

sidecar.gloss: A course closure and meal delivery fall on opposite sides of a pickup.
sidecar.rival_reading: A maintenance crew could have used the course during field work; the receipt does not say why the pickup was arranged.

row.body: A tee sheet has two copies: one marks the grounds open, the other says to keep carts away until the test strip is dry.
row.title: The second tee sheet

sidecar.gloss: Two course notices disagree about whether the grounds were ready.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response crew could have restricted the grounds while checking a spill; the sheet does not identify the substance.
